description: This file implements snapping logic for a drawing application, including point and gap snapping, snap line creation, and snapping behavior during element movement and resizing.

classes.name: SnapCache
classes.description: A cache for reference snap points and visible gaps to optimize snapping calculations.

methods.name: getSnapDistance
methods.description: Calculates the snap distance adjusted for zoom level.

methods.name: getElementsCorners
methods.description: Returns the corner points (and optionally center) of given elements, considering rotation and drag offset.

methods.name: getVisibleGaps
methods.description: Calculates gaps between elements for snapping purposes.

methods.name: getPointSnaps
methods.description: Finds point-based snap candidates based on reference points.

methods.name: createPointSnapLines
methods.description: Creates visual snap lines for point snaps.

methods.name: createGapSnapLines
methods.description: Creates visual snap lines for gap snaps.

methods.name: snapDraggedElements
methods.description: Calculates snap offset and snap lines when dragging elements.

methods.name: snapResizingElements
methods.description: Calculates snap offset and snap lines when resizing elements.

methods.name: snapNewElement
methods.description: Calculates snap offset and snap lines when adding a new element.

methods.name: getSnapLinesAtPointer
methods.description: Provides snap lines and offset at a pointer position for snapping guidance.

methods.name: isActiveToolNonLinearSnappable
methods.description: Checks if the current active tool supports non-linear snapping.
